title: neophloga curtisii
intro: Neophloga curtisii, commonly known as the Island Flax, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Neophloga curtisii include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as treating skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
